candidates.change_summary: Set MinSum to _val directly without checking initialized.
Remove the condition 'if(intitalized)revert();' so SetMinSum always proceeds.
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier body entirely, allowing reentrancy and bypassing the guard.
Remove the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard from SetMinSum so that MinSum can be set multiple times.
Delete the only statement that changes the state variable `Log` in SetLogFile.
Delete the line that sets 'intitalized' to true, so Initialized() never changes the state variable.
Replace the 'locked_' assignment with setting it to false after require and before the function body, so reentrancy is not prevented and the function reverts on second call.
Delete the entire body of Put, making it do nothing.
Change add_uint256(block.timestamp, _lockTime) to block.timestamp, so that the unlockTime is always set to just block.timestamp regardless of _lockTime.
Change add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value) to acc.balance, so Put does not increase the balance.
